lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Correction and reflection: storage and final cleanup

standardsRefs: Ready for Life v1, Grade 4 Unit 3: Kitchen Care and Food Safety
Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice storage and final cleanup. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: The learner reads a short written description of how a kitchen was left after a food task: some items put away correctly, others left out, uncovered, or stored the wrong way.
materials: learner-local: paper or a notes app

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Of the three mistakes in the scenario, which one do you think you would be most likely to make without thinking, and what specific reminder would help you catch it next time?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Mistake identification: All three mistakes are found and correctly labeled by type. | Correction specificity: All three corrections name a specific food, location, or step, and the rewritten ending reads as a coherent finished cleanup. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner write their own three-mistake scenario based on something real from their household, trade it with an adult in the household, and check whether the adult finds the same three mistakes the learner intended.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can practice storage and final cleanup. I will do one step at a time and check one result.

duration.elapsedWindow: Two short sessions across one day; no continuous monitoring
duration.sessionPattern: 5 minutes model, 5–7 minutes guided try, 10–15 minutes learner task, 5 minutes evidence and retry check
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

resources.title: storage and final cleanup worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner reads a short written description of how a kitchen was left after a food task: some items put away correctly, others left out, uncovered, or stored the wrong way.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact storage and final cleanup decision or action.
Model move 2: Before reading the scenario, list what 'finished' should mean for kitchen cleanup.
Model move 3: Read the cleanup scenario carefully and find the three specific mistakes, marking each one where it appears.

Model check: Mistake identification: All three mistakes are found and correctly labeled by type. | Correction specificity: All three corrections name a specific food, location, or step, and the rewritten ending reads as a coherent finished cleanup.

resources.title: storage and final cleanup action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for storage and final cleanup.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: storage and final cleanup coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner reads a short written description of how a kitchen was left after a food task: some items put away correctly, others left out, uncovered, or stored the wrong way.
Coach direction: Before reading the scenario, list what 'finished' should mean for kitchen cleanup.
Learner prompt: Name two specific things that should be true about a kitchen when cleanup is actually finished, not just started.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: storage and final cleanup complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Read the cleanup scenario carefully and find the three specific mistakes, marking each one where it appears.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I found and marked all three mistakes in the scenario, not just one or two.
Response 2 (t2-p2): For each mistake, I labeled whether it was a food-storage mistake or a surfaces-and-trash mistake.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: storage and final cleanup minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Of the three mistakes in the scenario, which one do you think you would be most likely to make without thinking, and what specific reminder would help you catch it next time?

Success checks: Mistake identification: All three mistakes are found and correctly labeled by type. | Correction specificity: All three corrections name a specific food, location, or step, and the rewritten ending reads as a coherent finished cleanup.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: storage and final cleanup supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional storage and final cleanup condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Mistake identification: All three mistakes are found and correctly labeled by type. | Correction specificity: All three corrections name a specific food, location, or step, and the rewritten ending reads as a coherent finished cleanup..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g4-u03-l06-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

simulationRoute.title: storage and final cleanup — complete fictional route

simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
